stories.title: Assam’s Bodoland becomes first tribal council to digitise land records
stories.summary: Over 15 lakh land documents, including maps, digitised across 8,970 sq. km Bodoland Territorial Region The available reporting identifies the immediate development, but further evidence is needed to assess implementation, responses and longer-term consequences. Material details remain pending. Additional reporting may clarify the scale, response and longer-term consequences for affected people and institutions.
stories.why_it_matters: The decision concerns the exercise and oversight of public power. Its practical impact will depend on transparent implementation, institutional follow-through and whether affected people can obtain timely reasons, review or remedy.
stories.evidence_status: The account is based on reporting by The Hindu - States. Official claims, allegations and projections remain attributed; underlying records were not independently reviewed unless a linked report states otherwise.
